date:herod-slays-male-children@7d6db1.note: Timed by Herod's enquiry of the wise men, while he lived (2:7, 2:16). The BC year depends on dating Herod's death outside Scripture.

date:joseph-and-mary-flee-to-egypt@7d6db.note: Fled before Herod died (2:15). The BC year depends on dating Herod's death outside Scripture.

date:joseph-and-mary-return-from-egypt@7.note: Came back after Herod was dead (2:19). The BC year depends on dating Herod's death outside Scripture.

date:joseph-and-mary-return-to-nazareth@.note: After Herod's death, when Archelaus reigned in Judaea (2:22). The BC year depends on dating Herod's death outside Scripture.

date:wise-men-visit-herod@7d6db1.note: Herod the king reigned then (2:1), and was alive when he met them (2:7). The BC year depends on dating his reign outside Scripture.

date:wise-men-visit-jesus@7d6db1.note: The visit came before the flight to Egypt (2:11, 2:13), while Herod lived. The BC year depends on dating Herod's death outside Scripture.

occurred-at:wise-men-visit-jesus>bethleh.note: Herod sent them to Bethlehem (2:8). The star stopped over the young child there, in a house (2:9, 2:11).

occurred-at:john-the-baptist-begins-mini.note: He preached in the wilderness of Judaea (3:1); the baptisms were in Jordan (3:6). Placing the ministry at Jordan is a reading of the setting.

occurred-at:seaside-parables-and-miracle.note: The storm is on 'the sea' (8:24). The Sea of Galilee is named only at 4:18, so this is a reading.

occurred-at:joseph-and-mary-return-from-.note: Text: they came into the land of Israel, and Joseph turned aside to Galilee, fearing Archelaus in Judaea (2:21-22). Jerusalem is not named.

occurred-at:sermon-on-the-mount>jerusale.note: Text: he went up into a mountain (5:1). Jerusalem appears only in an oath (5:35) and as a source of crowds (4:25).
